messages.text: Well let's test out our messaging platform shall we? So as everyone is now aware, Stylez is no longer with us. I really liked the guy and hes obviously a very talented, experienced  DJ/MC.  I wish that management and he could have come to a mutual beneficial understanding about going forward. I also have been in many different positions over the years including being on the receiving end of the bullshit like Stylez believes he was. I purposefully stayed out of that conversation as much as possible as it was not mine to really have. I just made sure Stylez recongnized that I saw the worth in having him around and did everything that I could to help them come to a mutually beneficial agreement but I guess it was just not meant to be. I completely respect and appreciate what Stylez has done here over the years but I also respect that a man has to take care of his family and if a better offer appears on the table at any point you gotta do what you gotta do. I wish him well and hope that he finds the right situation for him at this point. I really did want to get to know him more and have another experienced vet with me to lead this rag tag group of rejects into battle!!!!! I'm kidding of course......... kinda....... No, I've already told you guys your strengths and the  things we need to improve upon in order to get where I wanna go and that is almost total domination of the mens club scene in boise in general but also grabbing a large demographic from the downtown clubs, especially on the weekends.. I really have no doubt that all three of you guys are going to be phenomenal at this in a way you never even knew you could be and take that on to bigger and better things whenever you are ready to leave this area or state or country. .ANNNDDDDD in the meantime, before you fly from the nest and engage upon your own life adventure in this or another business, I feel like YOU SHOULD BE MAKING A LOT OF MONEY!!!!
